{"subject":"Do not submit claim C021691 - duplicate of C004524","body":"Hi billing lead,

Please do not submit claim C021691 (patient PT0200, service code T1019, date of service 2026-09-04, 12 units, $73.20). The same member, service and date were already billed as C004524, and the payer's pre-check predicts a denial (D05) as a duplicate.

The claim cannot be fixed by editing it, so it should be held or closed rather than corrected and sent. Could you confirm once it has been pulled from the submission queue? It is currently scheduled for submission on 2026-10-25, so please confirm before that date.

Thank you."}
